Backfill sample_idx_raw and sample_names on an older peak_params

Source: R/peak_catalog.R
backfill_sample_idx_raw.Rd

sample_idx_raw and sample_names were added to estimate_peak_params() in a recent commit. peak_params objects saved before then lack these fields and cannot be used with build_peak_catalog() directly. This helper reconstructs sample_idx_raw from the per-sample peak count already stored in n_peaks$values and optionally attaches sample_names from a user-supplied vector.

Usage

backfill_sample_idx_raw(peak_params, sample_names = NULL)

Arguments

peak_params

An older peak_params object missing sample_idx_raw.

sample_names

Optional character vector of sample names. Must have length n_samples. If NULL, sample_names is not attached (the catalog doesn't need it; only the peak-params report does).

Value

A peak_params-shaped list with sample_idx_raw and (if provided) sample_names added.

Details

Peaks in the _raw vectors are stored in sample-then-detection order (all of sample 1's peaks, then all of sample 2's peaks, ...), and each sample contributes exactly n_peaks$values[i] entries. The reconstruction is rep(1:n_samples, n_peaks$values).

Sanity-checks that sum(n_peaks$values) == length(rt_loc_raw); if this fails, the peak_params object is inconsistent and must be regenerated by rerunning estimate_peak_params.
